source: Z-Anatomy, Gauthier Kervyn and contributors; original BodyParts3D reference
extraction: Evaluated endpoint vertex 1 of native Blender .j annotation lines (including Hook modifiers), not the text endpoint. No Wikipedia definitions copied.

registration.description: Global similarity registration of 22 matching source bone surfaces; source Z-up converted to Y-up first. Nearest-vertex distances include tessellation and model differences.

adaptation: Markers transferred to BodyParts3D 4.0 by global similarity registration, then nearest-vertex surface projection. Bilateral counterparts mirror the source reference before registration. This is educational registration, not an expert validation of all landmark locations.
